docs.purpose: Accepts one image as a data URL with its kind, scenario key, position and alt text; writes the row, the audit row and the bucket object, or nothing.
docs.data_story: It validates the body against media-contract.json, checks the size against media_upload_max_bytes and the magic bytes against the type, inserts media_assets and admin_audit_log in one transaction and uploads the object before COMMIT; a storage failure rolls the transaction back.
docs.under_126: A MUTATION CONTRACT with one audit row per success; idempotency by a server-assigned asset_id and the media_assets_report_order unique index.

notes: GET items are `{...row, temporal_group}` — a raw-row spread plus one computed field, not a hand-picked whitelist. POST/DELETE additionally require authMethod === 'session' (the shared admin_key sentinel is rejected 403; dev_bypass allowed) via forbiddenNonSessionWrite. POST insert is idempotent (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); DELETE is a hard delete scoped to admin_uid. NO admin audit row for the mutating methods. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: Census checklist: all 7 named tables VERIFIED. Census MISSED `profiles` (verifyAdminAuth, src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:117-120). FINDINGS: (1) COMMENT/CODE DISAGREEMENT — src/lib/admin/watchlist-temporal.ts:29 documents opportunity_score as 'MAX(opportunity_score) across the lead's active-trade forecasts', and :74 repeats 'MAX(opportunity_score) across all rows'; the actual GET SQL takes opportunity_score from the SAME row as the earliest predicted_start (route.ts:145-159, :185-199), which the route header at :25-28 correctly describes as same-row semantics. The JS mirror aggregateForecastRows (watchlist-temporal.ts:86-104) really does compute MAX, so the client-side reconcile helper and the server SQL can disagree for a lead whose max-score trade is not its earliest-start trade. (2) skipped_existing is derived arithmetically as valid.length - added (route.ts:365), so an INTRA-batch duplicate is reported as 'skipped_existing' even on a first-ever save — acknowledged in the comment at :338-339. (3) The POST INSERT builds its VALUES list by string concatenation (:341-351) but every value is a bound parameter ($1..$N) — parameterised, not injectable. (4) No SELECT * on a base table: the `SELECT *` at :120 reads the explicit-column subquery aliased `board` (:121-202). (5) No admin_audit_log row for either mutation, unlike the user-management routes — only breadcrumb + PostHog. (6) `dev_bypass` mutations are permitted (:73-79), so on a dev-mode deployment all rows land under uid 'dev-user' (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:82). | Caching: none observed — no Cache-Control, no dynamic/revalidate, no in-process memo in route.ts:1-430 | Pagination: GET: LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3 at src/app/api/admin/leads/watchlist/route.ts:204 bound to WATCHLIST_PAGE_SIZE=50 (src/lib/admin/watchlist-schemas.ts:52) and the Zod-clamped offset (int >=0, max 1_000_000, src/lib/admin/watchlist-schemas.ts:56); `total` from a separate COUNT(*) at route.ts:207-209, returned in meta at :251-255. POST/DELETE: batch size capped at 1000 by Zod (watchlist-schemas.ts:99, :121). | Other guards / classification: MUTATION-ONLY identity gate: forbiddenNonSessionWrite at src/app/api/admin/leads/watchlist/route.ts:73-81 rejects authMethod==='admin_key' with 403; 'dev_bypass' writes are deliberately PERMITTED (:74 tests only admin_key). CSRF Origin allowlist fires for POST/DELETE inside verifyAdminAuth (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:70-78, allowlist parse at :288-303, default-deny at :336). MFA gate inert unless ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED=true (:143). | Locking tests: src/tests/admin-watchlist.infra.test.ts.
